rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and must not be silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
For 2026-08-25, paid NOTE 5/5, BOOTH 5/5 and designated free NOTE 2/2 are strict verified; never republish them for Aug 26.
For 2026-08-26, the paid NOTE 5, BOOTH 5 and free NOTE 2 inventories are fully materialized but remain uncounted until strict public verification.
A paid scheduled slot that cannot reach verified publication is not discarded; it becomes paid publication debt.
Paid publication debt survives date changes and PC power-off periods until buyer/reader-visible publication is verified.
One run may complete multiple publications when a paid floor remains; do not stop after the first success.

Do not count queue insertion, local publisher success logs without strict verification, editor/admin URLs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or unverified pages as completed paid publications.
Cloud-side planning, queue production, duplicate reconciliation and publisher repair continue when Windows is unavailable.
For free NOTE, discover/reconcile an existing exact-title public page before any retry that could create a duplicate.
Current-day required IDs always outrank legacy blockers and stale prior-day enabled entries.
